you already had it, you may
spend it to get+1[recruit] and+1

If there is at least one Omen of Doom, all
Doombot Legions get+1[attack]. If there are at
least four Omens, then instead Doctor
Doom and all Doombot Legions get+2
[attack].
Always Leads: Doombot Legions
Master Strike: Stack this Strike next to Doctor
Doom as an “Omen of Doom.” Then each player
discards cards equal to the number of Omens or
gains a Wound.
Fight: You may recruit a[tech] or[range] Hero
from the HQ for free.
Doom blurs the lines between sorcery and hemiseismology.
Fight: If you fight Hand Ninjas in the Sewers
or Rooftops, KO one of your Heroes.
Otherwise, you get+1[recruit]
Moon’s glint unsheathing.
Single whisper’s perfection.
Night’s mist enfolds you.
Super-Skrull gets+1[attack] for each Hero
Class among Heroes in the HQ.
Fight: KO one of your Heroes.
Whenever you fight a Villain here, each
other player puts a Villain from their
Victory Pile into the
Escape Pile or gains a Wound.
Setup: 8 Twists.
Twists 1-3: Each player discards a card.
Twist 4: Each player discards two cards.
Twists 5-6: Each player gains a Wound.
Twist 7: Each player gains two Wounds.
Twist 8: Evil Wins!
Setup: 10 Twists. Stack 1 additional Twist next to this
Scheme as a “Killgorithm.”
Special Rules: Bystanders in the Villain Deck are “Killbot”
Villains with[attack] equal to the number of Killgorithms.
They have: “Fight: Rescue this as a Bystander.”
Twists 1-9: Add this Twist to the Killgorithms. Two
Killbots enter the city from the Bystander Deck.
Twist 10: All Killbots in the city escape.
Evil Wins: When there are 6 Bystander cards in the
Escape Pile.
